cards.card_text: The Geshurites and the Maacathites are two peoples living in that eastern land.
cards.verse_text: but the Israelites did not drive out the Geshurites or the Maacathites.
cards.snippet: but the Israelites did not drive out the Geshurites or the Maacathites.

cards.card_text: David lives in Philistine territory a year and four months, and in that time he and his men raid the Geshurites, the Girzites and the Amalekites.
cards.verse_text: Now David and his men went up and raided the Geshurites, the Girzites, and the Amalekites.
cards.snippet: Now David and his men went up and raided the Geshurites, the Girzites, and the Amalekites.
